4659-5224-6294-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
4659-5224-6294-7693.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Armor Wars, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-997-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2364-2829-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2364-2829-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Mana Vault, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

3188-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
3188-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Social Climber and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Social Climber and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-6259-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

2169-4694-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-5147-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-4247.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3327-4247.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

252-4231-4785-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-4785-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2728-6012-6798-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-6012-6798-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-6012-6798-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=1 that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

4050-5660-6854--35.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=1 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or {1} available otherwise.
4050-5660-6854--35.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying one mana, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

345-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

3147-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

3459-4395-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Lightning Prowess by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2760-4762-6081.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that has three or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2760-4762-6081.description:
Activate Black Panther by paying {3}, moving at least three +1/+1 counters from a land to Devoted Druid, then causing you to gain at least 3 life and draw a card.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 1.
2760-4762-6081.notes: If the land has four or more +1/+1 counters to start, you'll net additional mana each loop.

2577-5686-7390.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2713-3094-4659-7297-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-7297-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2781-6767-6798.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4785-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1809-1987-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and Scrivener.
When Returned Pastcaller and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1069-3228-3499-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-3499-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

3054-4050-6112.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1117-2510-2866-6518.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1117-2510-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

864-4050-6101.description:
Sacrifice Eternal Witness to Phyrexian Altar, adding {W}.
Cast Helping Hand, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Helping Hand from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1486-3459-5929--68.description:
Activate the creature with saddle's saddle ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the saddle ability.
Repeat.

1308-2457-2557-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-4109-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Deathspore Thallid has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-4109-4312.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Deathspore Thallid.
Activate Deathspore Thallid's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Deathspore Thallid if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo, and you may also optionally sacrifice the Saproling tokens to Deathspore Thallid's ability.

539-4004.description:
Cast Wormfang Turtle by paying {2}{U}.
When Wormfang Turtle enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Turtle.
When Wormfang Turtle leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

91-1656-1849-4050-4170.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Necrotic Ooze undying until end of turn.
If Necrotic Ooze has any +1/+1 counters, activate it using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Necrotic Ooze, adding {B}.
Necrotic Ooze dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.
You may also use the infinite Inkling tokens to use Fain's first ability for infinite +1/+1 counters.

322-1664-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven land cards in your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You have a basic land card either in hand or in your graveyard.
322-1664-4050.description:
Cast Worm Harvest for its retrace cost by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G} and discarding a land card from your hand, creating at least eight 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Worm tokens, adding {3}{B/G}{B/G}{B/G}{G}.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

603-1424-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond is attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-1424-5256.description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it to create 1/1 green Elf Warrior token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the token to mill target player one.
Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
